channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Creek Park South Extension, Parcel P2
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Creek Park South Extension, Parcel P2 (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park South Extension, Parcel P2: P2 shows 'existing' because Huffaker…
item.description: P2 shows 'existing' because Huffaker Park stands there today; the planned extension builds around it and may rework part of it. The 2015 plan entry on the timeline now describes the land planned as a park and no longer reads as P2's status. Source: Hoodline, 'Life on a Houseboat Is Mostly Ups, Few Downs', Apr 6, 2018 (https://hoodline.com/2018/04/life-on-a-houseboat-is-mostly-ups-few-downs/): "getting involved at nearby Huffaker Park"; Rec and Park schematic design for P2/P8 (undated): "The existing Huffaker Park will be preserved and incorporated into the park design".

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park South Extension, Parcel P2: Rec and Park's project page (re-read…
item.description: Rec and Park's project page (re-read October 17, 2026) gives the construction start as 'Late 2026 / Early 2027' and the public opening as 'TBD'. This record showed only '~2026' on Coming up and listed the same start twice; Coming up now shows the window once, and the record's What's next line gives the window in its text. Source: San Francisco Recreation and Parks Department, Mission Creek Park South Extension Project (https://sfrecpark.org/1833/Mission-Creek-Park-South-Extension-Proje), Estimated Project Schedule: "Construction begins , Late 2026 / Early 2027"; "Open to the Public , TBD".

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park South Extension, Parcel P2: P2 shows 'existing' for the Huffaker…
item.description: P2 shows 'existing' for the Huffaker Park path and community garden that stand there today, from Rec and Park's schematic design (undated). The planned Mission Creek Park South Extension on P2 and P8 is not built. The timeline now carries a matching entry, dated only by when we read the document. Source: San Francisco Recreation and Parks Department, Mission Creek Park South Extension Project - Schematic P2/P8 (https://sfrecpark.org/DocumentCenter/View/25950/Mission-Creek-Park-South-Extension-Project---Schematic-P2-P8): "The existing Huffaker Park will be preserved and incorporated into the park design"; "The existing community garden is 11,500 square feet.".

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park South Extension, Parcel P2: Rec and Park's project page calls the…
item.description: Rec and Park's project page calls the work "Mission Creek Park South extension project (Parcels 2 and 8)" and says it will "complete the last link in a string of Mission Bay's creekside open spaces". OCII's open-space page lists P2 as "Mission Creek Park", which would repeat the name of two other records, so the record uses the extension's name plus the parcel. Shape, status and use are unchanged; the old page address now redirects to the new one, and the old name still finds the record in search. Source: San Francisco Recreation and Parks, Mission Creek Park South Extension Project (https://sfrecpark.org/1833/Mission-Creek-Park-South-Extension-Proje), Scope of Work: "responsible for the development of Mission Creek Park South extension project (Parcels 2 and 8)"; OCII, Mission Bay South open space page (https://sfocii.org/projects/mission-bay-south/open-space): "P2 Mission Creek Park".

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park South Extension, Parcel P2: The P2 page now says its 'existing'…
item.description: The P2 page now says its 'existing' status describes only the Huffaker Park path and garden standing there today. The planned Mission Creek Park South Extension is not built: Rec and Park gives construction start as 'Late 2026 / Early 2027' (an expected date) and opening as 'TBD', and OCII's November 2024 map labels P2 and P8 'coming soon'. The timeline shows the expected construction start as 2026, and the 2019 date in OCII's 2015 plan as an estimated lease-termination date. Source: SF Recreation and Parks, Mission Creek Park South Extension Project (sfrecpark.org/1833/Mission-Creek-Park-South-Extension-Proje); OCII, Mission Bay Future Parks, CAC update, 2024-11-14 (sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf); OCII Mission Bay Long-Range Property Management Plan, Dec 2015.

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park South Extension, Parcel P2: The October 10, 2026 note about this…
item.description: The October 10, 2026 note about this change said P2 lost about 220 square metres that overlapped the east reach. Measured again from the outlines before and after the change, P2 lost nothing and gained about 2,520 square metres, and the two shapes had overlapped by about 1,220 square metres. The P2 accuracy note also said twice that P2 overlaps the existing Mission Creek Park shape; it now says so once. The shape on the map is unchanged. Source: Pier & Point editorial review.

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park South Extension, Parcel P2: P2 was shown as under construction
item.description: P2 was shown as under construction. Construction has not started: SF Recreation and Park's Mission Creek Park South Extension page gives construction beginning late 2026 or early 2027 and no opening date yet. The walkable part of P2 today is the existing Huffaker Park path and community garden, which the project's schematic design says will be preserved, with the path repaved to city standards. P2 now shows as existing, not yet redeveloped; the expected construction start stays on its timeline. Source: https://sfrecpark.org/1833/Mission-Creek-Park-South-Extension-Proje.

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park South Extension, Parcel P2: The P2 creek channel record's…
item.description: The P2 creek channel record's description, name and park use cited nothing. They now cite OCII's December 2019 Mission Bay Land Use Map (which labels P2) and SF Recreation and Park's Mission Creek Park South Extension project page (Parcels 2 and 8, a park along Mission Bay Drive and Channel Street). The record's 'under construction' status, set on 2026-09-20, is unchanged, but that page currently gives construction as beginning late 2026 or early 2027, so the status still needs a dated source or a further decision. Source: OCII, Mission Bay Land Use Map, 2019-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Att%201%20Mission%20Bay%20Land%20Use%20Map.pdf); SF Recreation and Park, Mission Creek Park South Extension Project (https://sfrecpark.org/1833/Mission-Creek-Park-South-Extension-Proje).

item.title: Existing · Mission Creek Park South Extension, Parcel P2: Hoodline, published April 6… (Apr 6, 2018)
item.description: Hoodline, published April 6, 2018, says a Mission Creek houseboat resident "makes up for it by getting involved at nearby Huffaker Park" (after saying she misses "a real garden with soil"), so a Huffaker Park was in use then. The article does not say where the park is. Rec and Park's schematic design (undated) calls Huffaker Park "existing" and says it "will be preserved and incorporated into the park design", and gives "The existing community garden is 11,500 square feet." It also says "the existing Huffaker Park path will remain in the same location and width while the paving material will be required to be improved to city standards". The date is the article's, which shows the park in use; it is not the date the park was built. The park stands today but is not at its final size: the planned extension builds around it and may rework part of it. No City page found says in its own words that the park is open today. (Apr 6, 2018). Source: Hoodline, 2018-04-06; San Francisco Recreation and Parks Department (document names Catellus and the San Francisco Redevelopment Agency).
item.source: Hoodline, 2018-04-06; San Francisco Recreation and Parks Department (document names Catellus and the San Francisco Redevelopment Agency)

item.title: Milestone · Mission Creek Park South Extension, Parcel P2: The land is planned as a… (Dec 2015)
item.description: The land is planned as a park: the Successor Agency's Approved Long-Range Property Management Plan for Mission Bay lists Park P2 ("Vacant Lot/Land") as a designated Open Space Park Parcel under the 1998 OPA, assigned to the Phase II Future Parks group; this is about the land planned as a park, the planned extension, and does not say what stands on P2 today (the plan's estimated lease-termination date for that phase was 2019, not a construction or opening date; the Mission Creek Park South Extension project now has its own schedule) (Dec 2015). Source: Mission Bay North and South Approved Long-Range Property Management Plan, Dec 2015.
